values.note: RVs and trailers $45 a night, $50 on holidays (3-night minimum); tents $38/$43; 15% off at 30+ nights on designated sites. Covers two adults and two children; extra children $5, adults $10. Boat launch $10 per stay. Read 2026-10-20.

values.note: Camping season: the last Sunday in April to the third Sunday in October.

season.source: https://www.wilsonvillecampground1.com/contact/3690931 ('Our Camping Season is the Last Sunday in April Till the 3rd. Sunday in October'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reservations: 2 nights or more at some sites, 7 or more at others, 3 over the Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends; first-come camping for 1 to 30 nights (operator's rules). No online or email booking: mail-in form from January 1, phone from April 25 (570-226-4382). Deposit one night (half for 30 nights, holidays paid in full); reservations held until 9 PM on arrival day. The camping page gives a $25 cancellation fee, the rules page $10.

summary: Confirmed $45 RV rate (2026), 160 sites, showers/laundry/store, seasonal (last Sun in April to 3rd Sun in October), the existing reservable/FCFS/2- and 7-night/holiday-3/30-night rules. Added platform phone (mail-in or phone only) and deposit/hold/cancellation terms to the booking note. Not stated by the operator: amperage, water or sewer at sites (left as derived from the note's dated review), dump station.
